facts.text: Quinnipiac University offers accelerated dual-degree (3+1 and 3+2) programs that allow students to earn undergraduate and graduate degrees in less time.

sources.title: Accelerated Dual-Degree (3+1 and 3+2) Programs | Quinnipiac University
sources.quote: Accelerated dual-degree (3+1 and 3+2) programs enable you to earn your undergraduate and graduate degrees in the most efficient and economical way possible.
